MINTY.gloss: relating to or suggestive of mint
MINTY.definition: Relating to or suggestive of mint.

TIME.gloss: an instance or single occasion for some event
TIME.definition: An instance or single occasion for some event.

MINE.gloss: excavation in the earth from which ores and minerals are extracted
MINE.definition: Excavation in the earth from which ores and minerals are extracted.

ITEM.gloss: a distinct part that can be specified separately in a group of things that could be…
ITEM.definition: A distinct part that can be specified separately in a group of things that could be enumerated on a list.
ITEM.example: He noticed an item in the New York Times.

MINT.gloss: a large number or amount or extent
MINT.definition: (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent.

YET.example: I have yet to see the results.

TEN.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one
TEN.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one; the base of the decimal system.

NET.gloss: a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the…
NET.definition: A computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange.

TIE.gloss: neckwear consisting of a long narrow piece of material worn under a collar and tied in…
TIE.definition: Neckwear consisting of a long narrow piece of material worn (mostly by men) under a collar and tied in knot at the front.
TIE.example: He stood in front of the mirror tightening his necktie.

MIN.gloss: a unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour
MIN.definition: A unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour.

TIN.gloss: a silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion
TIN.definition: A silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion; used in many alloys and to coat other metals to prevent corrosion; obtained chiefly from cassiterite where it occurs as tin oxide.

YEN.gloss: a yearning for something or to do something
YEN.definition: A yearning for something or to do something.

MITE.example: This dish could use a touch of garlic.
